build.buildCommand: if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "jarvis" ]; then npm run build -w @jarvis/shared && npm run build -w @jarvis/extension; else npm run build -w @jarvis/api; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ "$RAILWAY_SERVICE_NAME" = "jarvis" ]; then npm exec -w @jarvis/extension vite -- preview --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-4173}; else node apps/backend/dist/index.js; fi
